hints.s-1-1: After the first jump, go left, climb the ramp and follow it right before dropping back down.
hints.s-1-2: Right after the previous one: you land on it in the middle of the track.
hints.s-1-3: Heading down the canyon, on your right as the rock ledge starts to crumble.
hints.s-1-4: In the cave, after the first fence, go left along the mine-cart rails to the end.
hints.s-1-5: On the train, right in front of you after saving the first orphan.
hints.s-1-6: Right in front after saving the second orphan (the cage you lift by shooting the target).
hints.s-1-7: Break the long grey crate on the left: Woody figure.
hints.s-1-8: After the third orphan, smash the door with [△]; it is straight ahead.
hints.s-1-9: Four-cow area: lower the catapult with a ball, launch a cow, then launch yourself. The card is in the hole the cow made.
hints.s-1-10: Right after, ahead on the left, in front of a crate.
hints.s-1-11: Appears in front of you when you rescue the last orphan.
hints.s-2-1: At the start, run straight under the bed: Jessie figure.
hints.s-2-2: Coming out from under the bed, jump into the orange bin with the teepee on it.
hints.s-2-3: To the right, push the red box aside: the card is inside.
hints.s-2-4: From the red box go to the computer desk, cross to the boxes on the wall and on the one with a «?» jump and press [△].
hints.s-2-5: Climb back up, go around to the bed and find another «?»: jump and press [△].
hints.s-2-6: Leave Woody, switch to Buzz with [L1], pick Woody up with [□] and throw him with [R2] on top of the white dresser. Hamm pops out with the card.
hints.s-2-7: In the basement, break the vent at the foot of the stairs with [△].
hints.s-2-8: Go to the top of the stairs and jump onto the box.
hints.s-2-9: Slide down the banister to the ironing board.
hints.s-2-10: Climb the red boxes next to the stairs; it is in the corner, on top of the fridge.
hints.s-2-11: Jump to the left shelf and open the door with the red handle.
hints.s-2-12: Drop to the workbench and the floor; use the red box to reach the washing machine, grab the army man and throw him onto the card next to the pumpkin basket.
hints.s-2-13: As Jessie, climb to the workbench and zig-zag up the darts ([X] then [□] in the air) to another army man; the card is behind the cleaner bottles.
hints.s-3-1: In the asteroid field, first open area: destroy them all and it appears ahead.
hints.s-3-2: After the first wall-dodging section (direction + [X]), in the next open area full of asteroids.
hints.s-3-3: In the second, harder wall section: in the middle, just after one of the walls.
hints.s-3-4: On the planet, floating platforms with mines: get close, aim right with [L2] and heat the crystal with [R2]; hop on the passing platform and jump to the card.
hints.s-3-5: After sinking the 2 rocks, among platforms with mines: in the middle.
hints.s-3-6: Right after, near the right edge. The mist hides it a bit.
hints.s-3-7: In Zurg's base, past the giant drill, go right and look up: Buzz figure. A few wall jumps from the middle of the wall.
hints.s-3-8: On top of the first drill, to the left.
hints.s-3-9: Room with a «Z» floor: clear the room, shoot the 2 crystals under the floor and drop in. Opposite corner from the exit.
hints.s-3-10: On top of the second drill.
hints.s-4-1: As Jessie, turn left (coin capsule), climb up and follow the shelves to the upside-down bins on the blue cabinets. It is behind them.
hints.s-4-2: From the bins, jump to the lights and to the butterflies in the middle. The card is near the ceiling by two more butterflies; jump for it and get back with [□].
hints.s-4-3: From the butterflies, jump to the nearest light, cross to the front one (by the green house) and jump onto the green roof.
hints.s-4-4: Get Woody to the first ledge (tank with the red snake), throw him with Buzz onto the green roof and swing across the 3 golden hooks: Daycare figure.
hints.s-4-5: At the bottom of the green house ramp, round the right side: the head, on a brown stool.
hints.s-4-6: With your back to the ramp, behind the tropical-print armchair; on the purple octopus shelf, opposite corner: the body.
hints.s-4-7: Inside the easel with kids' drawings, past the big armchair: the gun.
hints.s-4-8: Past Hamm, wall-jump between the coat rack and the sink up to Rex. Turn around and use [□] on the hook to reach the cabinets.
hints.s-4-9: Bring Buzz next to Rex and throw Woody across the gap: the card is on top of the purple shelf.
hints.s-4-10: Drop onto the green desk and look underneath: the cape.
hints.s-4-11: The tricky one: Woody climbs to the first light and crosses 2 hooks to the last one. Buzz goes up the blue shelves to the silver chain, which takes him to Woody. Throw Woody into the open vent.
hints.s-4-12: Talk to Twitch (green bug by the ramp) and pop all 40 balloons with Bullseye.
hints.s-4-13: Talk to Sparks (robot at the back, by the green desk): Teeny Racer, smash all 10 block piles.
hints.s-4-14: Talk to Chunk (by the big armchair): Alley Throw, stop 100 aliens without missing. Holding [R2] fires repeatedly; co-op spawns 155.
hints.s-5-1: At the pink lamp, look up by the bulb and swing with [□] from the edge of the platform.
hints.s-5-2: Smash the block pile, wall-jump, flatten the book and smash the blocks underneath.
hints.s-5-3: Climb the books in the corner, shimmy along the narrow ledge and drop onto the book.
hints.s-5-4: After the floating green soaps, knock down the bag with a dash and keep left across 3 helicopters.
hints.s-5-5: Go back and jump onto the brown shelf: it is right there.
hints.s-5-6: Shimmy along the crayons on the wall, smash the blocks, cross the floating book before it rises and smash another pile.
hints.s-5-7: In the hamster cage, before leaving the first section: get on the blue platform, jump into the tunnel above and wall-jump up it.
hints.s-5-8: Past the tunnel and the floating books, from the pink bag jump to the green soap on the left.
hints.s-5-9: In the battery room, ride the lift to the purple ledge and, before going out, walk all the way left.
hints.s-5-10: On the second rail, jump to the first green loop on the right and then to the green line on the left. On the asteroid, go down-left and ground-pound the weak floor: Blue Dog figure.
hints.s-6-1: After opening Jessie's barrier, run to the back window and turn right: the alien prisoner, on a box.
hints.s-6-2: Push the red box, hop the wall and climb the nearest table; the card is on the next one.
hints.s-6-4: Under the table against the wall swept by the helicopter searchlights.
hints.s-6-5: Back corner near where Hamm is held: on the floor past the ramp.
hints.s-6-6: Hanging from the window sills towards Hamm's switch: the switch is to the left, the card to the right.
hints.s-6-7: Ground floor of Slinky's switch area: past the searchlights, on a shelf to your left.
hints.s-6-8: As Jessie, head toward Rex between the lights, climb the darts and wall-jump; to the right past the red switch, on a small shelf.
hints.s-6-9: Go back to the previous shelf and jump to the ceiling light on your left.
hints.s-6-10: Double jump straight ahead to the next light.
hints.s-7-1: After saving the aliens, Woody breaks the vent, climbs the ledge and swings with [□] on the handle up to the top.
hints.s-7-2: The first time you switch to Jessie, before breaking the fan, turn around and run left.
hints.s-7-3: Climb onto the box Buzz dropped and then the high ledge.
hints.s-7-4: Double jump under Buzz's ledge, turn left and jump the gap.
hints.s-7-5: As Woody: yellow-and-black pipe, avoid the electricity, climb 4 pipes, press the red button on the left and jump into the duct on the right. It is at the back.
hints.s-7-6: Jessie jumps onto the button that releases electricity (jump + [□]). Buzz climbs the corridor and drops a box off the back edge. Jessie climbs it and jumps left: alien Zurg.
hints.s-7-7: After stopping the crushers, as Woody, up and to the right of the uncovered duct.
hints.s-7-8: Crossing the blue floor toward the screen, right on the edge.
hints.s-7-9: As Jessie, cross the flaming pipes, the valve and the ledge.
hints.s-7-10: As Woody, swing across the handle to the next platform.
hints.s-7-11: Once Buzz hits the red switch, Woody crosses the swinging platforms and the last handle.
hints.s-8-1: From the start, go down the street to the left to the scaffolding: rock, ledge and all the way up.
hints.s-8-2: Facing the cake from the start, the building closest to it on the left (Tailor): top floor of the ruins.
hints.s-8-3: Second house on the left (Newspaper): second floor.
hints.s-8-4: Opposite, on the right (Saloon): second floor.
hints.s-8-5: First building on the right (Jail), once in ruins: at the very top.
hints.s-8-6: With your back to the cake from the start, the building in front of you (General Store): second floor.
hints.s-8-7: The destroyed building on the left (Barbershop): just jump.
hints.s-8-8: Let the green bubbles destroy the last building on the right (Bank): at the top.
hints.s-8-9: In the final boss, destroy every building on both main streets (shots, the witches' bubbles or the cannon). The last alien appears at the «T» junction.

s-5-7.miss: If you move on without it you must replay the level
